headline: 童節目網紅雷秋爾發聲
context: 美國幼兒節目網紅「雷秋爾老師」（Ms Rachel，本名 Rachel Accurso）近年在 YouTube 累積數十億次觀看，但她對加薩、LGBTQ 權益等議題的發言也引來爭議。雷秋爾原本是學前音樂老師，因兒子語言發展遲緩，七年前才開始拍片，如今她說自己的目標不是討好所有人，而是幫助孩子、說真話。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Her catchy videos have racked up billions of views, but Rachel Accurso’s statements on everything from Gaza to LGBTQ rights have caused a stir. She talks about screen time, song fatigue and speculation she might enter politics The YouTube star Ms Rachel, toddler whisperer extraordinaire, spots me before I clock her, and even from a distance and without her trademark pink T-shirt and denim dungarees, she is instantly recognisable by her wave, which is accompanied by an enthusiastic bounce. I half expect her to say, “Hi, friends”, as she does at the start of many of her videos. Instead she bounds over, wearing a classic off-duty mum uniform – Sesame Street sweatshirt, grey leggings, baseball cap that reads “Mama” – and removes her oversized sunglasses. She’s very sorry, she says, rubbing her eyes, that she is so tired – but her manner remains unfailingly, characteristically peppy. It is only seven years since Rachel Accurso, who used to be a preschool music teacher, uploaded her first video to YouTube, a counting song for preschoolers called Bubble, Bubble Pop! . She and her husband, Aron Accurso, who worked as a music director on Broadway, made the video because their one-year-old son had a speech delay and there seemed to be a dearth of quality videos online that could help toddlers learn to speak. 童節目網紅雷秋爾發聲

美國幼兒節目網紅「雷秋爾老師」（Ms Rachel，本名 Rachel Accurso）近年在 YouTube 累積數十億次觀看，但她對加薩、LGBTQ 權益等議題的發言也引來爭議。雷秋爾原本是學前音樂老師，因兒子語言發展遲緩，七年前才開始拍片，如今她說自己的目標不是討好所有人，而是幫助孩子、說真話。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 20 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
美國幼兒節目網紅「雷秋爾老師」（Ms Rachel，本名 Rachel Accurso）近年在 YouTube 累積數十億次觀看，是不少家長口中的「哄娃神器」，但她對加薩、LGBTQ 權益等議題的發言，也讓她捲入不少爭議。雷秋爾原本是學前音樂老師，七年前因為兒子語言發展遲緩、又找不到夠好的教學影片，才和身兼百老匯音樂總監的先生亞倫一起拍了第一支影片。如今她說，自己的目標從來不是討好所有人，而是幫助孩子、說真話，即使這代表她得一直面對外界的放大檢視。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 20 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 美國幼兒節目網紅雷秋爾老師，最近談了自己一路走來的爭議。她的影片在 YouTube 上累積了數十億次觀看，但她對加薩、LGBTQ 權益等議題的發言，也讓她捲入不少爭議。她原本是學前音樂老師，七年前因為兒子語言發展遲緩，才開始拍片教小小孩說話。她說，自己的目標從來不是討好所有人，而是幫助孩子、說真話。
